en-US.subtitle: Exam prep in 10 minutes a day
en-US.promotionalText: Ready on exam day. Add your notes, get questions you can check, answer in your own words and see how ready you are for every exam.
en-US.description:
Capling is the study coach for exam day. Spend 10 to 15 minutes a day and know where you stand.

Add what your class gave you. Capling turns it into questions you can check, brings them back just before you would forget them, and shows how ready you are for each exam.

BRING IN YOUR CLASS
• Scan pages, import a PDF (slides too, saved as PDF) or paste text
• Snap the syllabus or a past paper. Cap reads the date, the topics and the format, and you check them
• Record a lecture. It is transcribed on your iPhone, and the moments that matter ("this will be on the midterm", or your own tap) are marked. Tap a time to hear it again
• Bring your Quizlet and Anki sets, or a CSV

QUESTIONS YOU CAN CHECK
• Questions from your notes link back to the page, and Cap circles the lines. Anything else is marked
• New questions arrive as drafts: you approve, edit or skip
• Flashcards, multiple choice, fill in the blank and label the diagram

ANSWER IN YOUR OWN WORDS
• Capling highlights the key ideas you covered and tells you what is missing
• Study out loud on the bus or at the gym: Cap asks, you answer, even with the screen off. Your voice isn't recorded
• Teach Cap a topic and see what you left out

KNOW WHERE YOU STAND
• Readiness for every exam and every topic
• Mock exams like the real one, with no marks until the end
• A plan that bends when your week does, and an exam-eve session: weak spots, then sleep

CAP NOTICES
• Questions about to fade before an exam, two ideas you keep mixing up, a topic with no notes, a date your lecturer mentioned
• One card at a time, three a day at most

ASK CAP
• Ask about your own notes and get answers that point to the page they came from
• Stuck on a problem? Snap it. Cap starts with hints and works through the method from your notes
• Ask Cap to draft questions, a quiz, a note or an exam date. Nothing is added without your yes, unless you turn on "Let Cap do it"
• Cloud AI is optional and off until you turn it on. Without it, questions and grading run on your iPhone, more simply

A HABIT THAT IS KIND
• Your memory sky: every question is a star that dims as you start to forget it and lights up when you review it
• Streaks with freezes, small daily quests, badges and sky themes to unlock. No hearts, and your best streak is kept. Quiet mode hides it all
• Widgets, an exam-week Live Activity and gentle reminders

FREE TO START
Always free: reviews and flashcards, as many as you like; a plan and readiness for every exam; mock exams; your streak, quests and the sky; Quizlet and Anki imports. With Cloud AI on, each week: 3 AI scans and AI notes for 1 lecture; each day: 20 graded answers and 10 questions for Cap.

With Cloud AI on, Capling Pro lifts those limits: AI scans, PDFs and lecture notes with no weekly limit, own-words answers graded by Cloud AI, Cap's answers and drafts with no daily limit, and web research from trusted sites (18 and over). Fair use applies. Choose a yearly plan with a free trial, a monthly plan, or Squad, which shares Pro with up to three friends. An Exam Pass gives you 30 days of Pro, one time, with nothing to cancel.

Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel them in your Apple Account settings.

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
en-US.reviewNotes:
Capling needs no account or demo login. All of this works on a fresh install with Cloud AI off, unless it says otherwise.

FIRST RUN
Go through the welcome and four questions; pick an exam about a week away. iOS may show its age range sheet and the notification prompt. At "Let's make your first set" choose "Use our sample page", add the questions and answer the two it asks. Then "See my plan", "Start my plan", "Continue free". Settings is your initial at the top of Today.

MICROPHONE AND SPEECH (audio background mode)
Asked for only on first use. No spoken audio is stored or sent.
- Today > Study out loud > Start: Cap reads questions aloud and hears your answers, also with the screen locked. With Cloud AI on, the words of an own-words answer go to be graded; never the voice.
- + > Record a lecture: records, also with the screen locked, and writes it out on the iPhone. Capling never uploads the recording.
- Library > a course > touch and hold a topic > Teach Cap > Say it.

CALENDAR
Asked for only on "Check my calendar" on Cap's card "Cap can plan around your long days". The card needs an exam within 14 days and two days of study, so a fresh install won't show it: see the attached screenshot. The app reads only the times of events marked busy, on the iPhone. Nothing from the calendar leaves it.

CAMERA AND PHOTOS
Asked for only on first use: + > Scan pages; Progress > an exam > ... > Edit exam > Snap the syllabus; the camera in Ask, for a problem. A syllabus or problem photo is read on the iPhone and isn't kept. Photos come through Apple's picker.

FREE MOCK EXAM
Free, no purchase. A mock needs 8 questions of the exam's kinds, and the sample page gives 6. So: + > Paste text, paste the passage below, Make questions, Add. Then Progress > your exam > Mock exam > Take it.

SQUAD
One plan for up to four people. Needs a sandbox purchase and a sign-in: Settings > Subscription > See Pro and Squad; Settings > Account; Settings > Squad > Invite a friend gives a code. Members see only first names, join dates and, for those who turn on "Show when I've studied" (off by default), a mark on days they finished a session. No messages, no shared notes. Joining takes a code from the owner, who can remove anyone.

CLOUD AI
Off until allowed. Settings > AI and privacy > Use Cloud AI shows the consent sheet: what is sent, and that OpenAI processes it through our server. Off, rules on the iPhone answer. Cap's work is a draft the student approves, unless they turn on "Let Cap do it". Web research is Pro only, off under 18, on a fixed list of sites. With Cloud AI on, the app prepares a last look by itself in the two days before an exam, and answers a question kept for later once online (fetch background mode).

PURCHASES
Pro, Squad and the Exam Pass. "Continue free" and Restore are on the paywall. Plans, readiness and mock exams are free.

ACCOUNT AND AGE
Settings > Account > Delete account. Declared Age Range: under 13, Cloud AI stays off and nothing is sold; under 18, hints first and no web research.

PASSAGE
Meiosis is the cell division that makes eggs and sperm. It produces four daughter cells, each with half the chromosomes of the parent cell. Crossing over happens in prophase I, when homologous chromosomes swap segments of DNA. This creates genetic variation. Mitosis, by contrast, produces two identical daughter cells. Enzymes are proteins that speed up chemical reactions by lowering the activation energy. The active site is the part of an enzyme where the substrate binds. Temperature and pH both change how fast an enzyme works, and too much heat denatures it. Photosynthesis is the process by which plants turn light energy into glucose. It takes place in the chloroplast, and chlorophyll is the pigment that absorbs the light. Cellular respiration releases energy from glucose and takes place mainly in the mitochondria.
